basics.name: Michael Mabinuola
basics.title: Database Engineer
basics.tagline: Vector Search, Performance and Data Pipelines

experience.companyDescription: IT service and consulting company specializing in SingleStore DB.
highlights: Perform online and offline database migrations.
Diagnose and resolve SingleStore performance bottlenecks for on-premise customers using query profiles, execution plans and OS-level metrics.
Tune SingleStore for vector data storage and retrieval; benchmark and evaluate vector index performance.
Build semantic search systems and RAG-based AI pipelines, and provide technical support for AI search and vector functions.
Design Apache Kafka data pipelines that simulate customer workloads for proofs of concept (PoC).
Write technical reports and documentation in English and Korean.
Evaluate competing database systems against SingleStore on architecture, performance, and features, and write comparison reports that support customer and internal decisions.

experience.companyDescription: Telematics company that fuses Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and GPS data to detect driving patterns.
highlights: Designed and implemented end-to-end ETL pipelines processing 1M+ rows daily from 300+ users.
Built an SVM model that classified road vs. sidewalk driving with 92% accuracy.
Developed algorithms to detect driving maneuvers: U-turns, rapid turns, overtaking.
Co-developed a driving behavior scoring system for usage-based insurance.
Configured real-time workflow monitoring and alerting in Apache Airflow.
Ran data quality validation to ensure accuracy and integrity, and maintained KPI monitoring dashboards.

projects.title: Vector search with Matryoshka embeddings
projects.summary: Ran the benchmarks for a co-authored study published on the SingleStore blog: two-stage search on 10M vectors cut index memory 87% and raised throughput 6.6x at 96% recall.

metrics.source: Published blog post; all figures are public.
metrics.method: ANN index on a sub-vector retrieves candidates; full 1024-dimension vectors rerank to top 5.

projects.title: Unlimited storage PoC on VAST object storage
projects.summary: Validated VAST as S3-compatible storage for SingleStore: lifecycle tests (backup, HA, PITR, scaling), TPC-H benchmarks on hot and cold tiers, and throughput under load.
projects.confidential: Results cannot be shared. Describe scope only; never show or invent numbers.

projects.title: Hamming distance for SingleStore
projects.summary: Built a Rust WebAssembly UDF that adds Hamming distance over binary vectors, which SingleStore lacks natively, and published the guide on the company wiki.

projects.title: Query profile analysis tool
projects.summary: Building an internal tool that analyzes SingleStore query profiles in on-premise environments, for use by the support team.

education.credential: Google Career Certificate in Advanced Data Analytics

writing.title: Vector search with Matryoshka embeddings
writing.summary: Two-stage vector search on 10M vectors: 87% less index memory and 6.6x throughput at 96% recall. I ran the benchmarks; co-authored with SingleStore engineers.

writing.title: High-dimension vectors in SingleStore
writing.summary: Tested indexing, inserts, and KNN/ANN search on vectors from 16K to 131K dimensions (up to 98 GB), and showed the real insert limit is max_allowed_packet, not the column type.

writing.title: Hamming distance for SingleStore
writing.summary: A Rust WebAssembly UDF that adds Hamming distance over binary vectors, which SingleStore lacks natively.

writing.title: On-premises RAG with Llama 2 and SingleStore
writing.titleLocal: On-Premises Llama 2 및 SingleStoreDB 를 이용한 생성형 AI 프로그램 예제
writing.summary: A CPU-only RAG example: a quantized Llama 2 model answers from context retrieved out of a SingleStore vector store, using LangChain and llama.cpp.
